_: How this repository is read against the Quran.ws terminology standard. See https://github.com/quranws/guidelines.
_exclude: work/ is the build's scratch copy of the KFGQPC packages; the two counting files are vendored verbatim from quranpedia/qiraat-ayah-map and are corrected upstream, not here — their English names are replaced on load, see pipeline/qurantext/counting.py. out/ is generated from pipeline/ and the audit already skips it.
_ignore_words: `part` and `parts` are ordinary English here — a part of a word, riwayat that part company — and never the juz.
_external_names: Names this repository does not own: the KFGQPC package, member and font names; the columns of their CSVs; Unicode character names; and the upstream repository. They are quoted, not chosen, so they are read as locators rather than as names.
